items.html: And know that I once heard that at first, at the time of the Ibur, the essence of ZA was only the aspect of NHY; for indeed, from the root of the NHY of AA he was then corrected in the days of the Ibur. Then his HGT were in potential and not in actuality, for his NHY, which are three complete measures, served for six small measures, as above. And now, through his nursing from the breasts that stand in the chest, in the three middles of Ima, therefore his middles were also revealed, and they too became three complete measures and also grew; and ZA was now of complete VAK and complete measures.
